business.name: Cormorant Mobile Detailing
business.summary: Mobile car detailing in San Francisco. We come to you, mobile only with no shop to drive to.

offerings.name: The Skiff
offerings.description: Exterior wash: foam hand wash, wheels and tires, door jambs, outside glass and a hand dry. This one doesn't touch the inside of the vehicle.
offerings.notes: Starting prices are for Class A, our smallest vehicles. Any larger vehicle costs more. The Skiff doesn't need power.

offerings.name: The Cutter
offerings.description: Interior detail: vacuum the seats, carpets, mats and trunk, wipe down the dash, console and door panels, do the inside glass and spot-clean.
offerings.notes: The Cutter doesn't include shampoo, pet hair removal or any exterior work. Needs a grounded 120-volt outlet within 75 feet or generator for a fee.

offerings.name: The Schooner
offerings.description: Full detail: everything in the Skiff and the Cutter plus a spray wax.
offerings.notes: Comes with a spray wax. Needs a grounded 120-volt outlet within 75 feet or generator for a fee.

offerings.name: The Flagship
offerings.description: Top package: everything in the Schooner plus a clay bar treatment, one-step machine polish, 6-month paint sealant and upholstery and carpet shampoo. Pet hair removal and odour treatment still cost extra.
offerings.notes: Pet hair removal and odour treatment still cost extra. Needs a grounded 120-volt outlet within 75 feet or generator for a fee.

addons.name: Pet hair removal
addons.requires: The Cutter, The Schooner or The Flagship
addons.notes: Cormorant Mobile Detailing cannot add pet hair removal to a Skiff and does not do it on its own.

addons.name: Upholstery and carpet shampoo
addons.requires: The Cutter or The Schooner; already included in The Flagship

addons.name: Odour treatment
addons.requires: The Cutter, The Schooner or The Flagship
addons.notes: Cormorant Mobile Detailing offers odour treatment for smoke, mildew or a musty car as an ozone treatment of either 1 hour or 2 hours and the technician chooses after a smell test on arrival. Cormorant Mobile Detailing cannot do odour treatment by itself.

addons.name: Clay bar
addons.requires: The Skiff or The Schooner; already included in The Flagship
addons.notes: The clay bar lifts bonded grit off the paint.

addons.name: 6-month paint sealant
addons.requires: Together with the clay bar, on a Skiff or a Schooner; both are already in the Flagship

addons.name: Headlight restoration
addons.notes: Cormorant Mobile Detailing prices headlight restoration per pair at any vehicle size and it takes about 45 minutes. You can book it on its own with no other service. There's no deposit for a headlight-only visit but the usual travel fee applies.

fees.label: Generator fee
fees.applies_when: Cormorant Mobile Detailing runs its generator when The Cutter, Schooner or Flagship does not have a grounded 120-volt outlet within 75 feet of the vehicle.

fees.label: Same-day fee
fees.applies_when: Same-day booking, only for a Skiff or a Cutter in that day's afternoon window if a technician is free and customer called before 10:00 am.

facts.statement: Cormorant Mobile Detailing defines Class A as coupes, hatchbacks, compact cars such as Civic, Corolla, Mini Cooper, Mazda3.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing defines Class B as sedans, crossovers, 2-row SUVs such as Camry, Model 3, Model Y, CR-V, Outback.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing defines Class C as 3-row SUVs, minivans, compact vans, standard pickups such as Highlander, Tahoe, Odyssey, Transit Connect, Tacoma, F-150, Ram 1500.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing defines Class D as full-size cargo and passenger vans, extended SUVs, heavy-duty pickups such as Transit, Sprinter, ProMaster, Express, Suburban, F-250, Ram 2500.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing is mobile only and there is no shop to drive to.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing is licensed and insured.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing is owner-run and Ines Calloway and Theo do all the work themselves.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing will come back and redo a missed area for free if the customer sends a photo within 48 hours.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing does not do cash refunds, and the redo does not cover stains or scratches that were already there.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing asks customers with more than one car or who want regular visits to ask about discounts.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing starting prices are for Class A, its smallest vehicles, and any larger vehicle costs more.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing states that excessive pet hair or heavily soiled vehicles may cost extra.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing confirms the final price when staff see the vehicle, with add-ons and some fees on top.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing works on cars, SUVs, pickups, minivans and vans, and electric vehicles and soft-top convertibles are fine.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing carries its own water in a 65-gallon tank, which covers up to 2 vehicles.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing needs a working spigot within 100 feet for 3 or more vehicles.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing requires a grounded 120-volt outlet within 75 feet of the vehicle for the Cutter, Schooner and Flagship, or staff run the generator for a $30 fee.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing states its generator cannot run in an enclosed or underground garage, so without an outlet those packages cannot be done in there.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing requires the vehicle to be in a driveway, private lot, open garage or street space that stays legal for the whole job with at least 3 feet clear on both sides.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing needs somewhere within 100 feet for its work van.

Cormorant Mobile Detailing requires apartment, condo and HOA-managed lot customers to get the building manager's permission before booking, does not contact managers itself, and refusal on the day counts as a no-show.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing asks customers to take out personal belongings, child seats and cargo, and states areas still full of belongings do not get cleaned and the price does not drop.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing requires an adult to hand over the keys at the start and stay reachable until finished.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing requires any job of 5 hours or more with add-ons to start in the morning window.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing works Tuesday to Saturday and is closed Sunday and Monday.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing offers arrival windows, not exact times, of 8:00 am to 9:30 am and 1:00 pm to 2:30 pm Tuesday to Friday, and morning window only on Saturday.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing office hours are Monday to Saturday, 8am to 6pm.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing normally needs at least 24 hours' notice before the start of the arrival window.

Cormorant Mobile Detailing only offers same-day service if the customer calls before 10:00 am, only for a Skiff or Cutter, only in that day's afternoon window and only if a technician is free, with a $40 same-day fee.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing closes for some holidays and over the winter, and if a date is not on the booking calendar staff are not working that day.

Cormorant Mobile Detailing moves exterior work if rain is in the forecast, notifies the customer the evening before, the customer will not lose the deposit over it, and interior-only jobs still go ahead.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing takes a $50 deposit to book any job, or $150 for the Flagship, and it counts toward the total, with no deposit on a headlight-only visit.

Cormorant Mobile Detailing takes the deposit by card link for Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay and Google Pay, and the balance is due when the job is finished with cash allowed for that part.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing refunds the full deposit for cancellation at least 48 hours before the start of the arrival window, half back between 24 and 48 hours, and nothing back under 24 hours.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing allows one free reschedule with at least 24 hours' notice by phone or text only, and any later or shorter-notice change counts as a cancellation.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing warns customers to make sure staff can get to the car when they arrive or they could lose the deposit.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing sells emailed gift cards for any whole-dollar amount from $50 to $1,000, they never expire, and they can be used on any job including deposits and fees.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing is based in San Francisco and travels further for a fee, as shown on the home page map.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing includes a spray wax with the Schooner and offers a longer-lasting 6-month paint sealant as an upgrade.
Cormorant Mobile Detailing asks customers to tell it who they are and where the vehicle will be on the booking page, then pick a time, or call or text 415-555-0142 or email cormorant@example.com.

not_offered.name: Flagship on matte paint, satin paint or vinyl wraps
not_offered.statement: Cormorant Mobile Detailing does not offer the Flagship on matte paint, satin paint or vinyl wraps.

not_offered.name: Clay, polish or seal on matte paint, satin paint or vinyl wraps
not_offered.statement: Cormorant Mobile Detailing does not clay, polish or seal matte paint, satin paint or vinyl wraps, so no clay bar or paint sealant on those.
